User confirmed the HDMI beep works.

image_provenance: The image and kernel hashes for these physical listening tests were not captured in the reports. Do not attribute the results to a specific current build. A new Pi boot and audio check is pending.
scope_note: This supersedes earlier diagnostic records that said HDMI audio was unimplemented or that physical output was unverified. It accepts audible basic tones on the user's Pi 4B over both analog and HDMI, and audible Oh Great/Psalmody playback over HDMI. It does not verify audio quality, latency, continuous PCM fidelity, every sound program, other Pi revisions, or the image currently staged on the microSD.
